- .github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml:69-71 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The step "Extract repository learnings (fail-open)" declares `timeout-minutes: 10` twice (lines 69 and 71).
  WHY: yamllint reports key-duplicates at 71:9, which fails static-checks and the lint job. All reviewers rated it BLOCKER. The fix is to delete line 71.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3293-3335 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: With the flag unset, the new `_clone_for_memory_branch` wrapper (lines 3305-3318) runs a full-history single-branch clone with no `--depth`. This bypasses the #8287 depth-1 fast path in `_full_clone_for_memory_branch` (lines 3240-3267).
  WHY: Each memory write refetches 260k+ commits (135-209 s per clone), which can exhaust the job cap again. It also fails `test_clone_for_memory_branch_is_shallow_and_single_branch` and `test_clone_for_memory_branch_falls_back_to_full_clone_when_fast_clone_fails`. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER from four reviewers, MAJOR from openai_gpt-6-luna. The performance sections of the other reviewers also gave MAJOR.
- tests/test_memory_maintenance_contract_noop.py:506-516 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_legacy_call_args` encodes the pre-#8287 call order (clone, then ls-remote), but the real `_full_clone_for_memory_branch` starts with an `ls-remote` probe and may take a depth-1 clone. The consumers are `test_flag_off_runs_legacy_full_clone_exactly`, `test_invalid_flag_value_disables_single_branch_clone_with_warning` and `test_single_branch_clone_failure_falls_back_to_full_clone`.
  WHY: tests-hooks-and-orchestrator reports 11 failures with "At index 0 diff: ['ls-remote', ...] != ['clone', ...]". Other reviewers cite lines 507-515, 591, 620 and 637 or 501-512 for the same helper and consumers.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3227-3230 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `_full_clone_for_memory_branch` comment, `changelog.d/8295-memory-single-branch-clone.md` and `agents.d/8295-memory-single-branch-clone.md` call it a "legacy full-repo clone, unchanged". It is actually the #8287 depth-1 fast path with a full-clone fallback, and the changelog overlaps `changelog.d/8287-memory-branch-shallow-clone.md`.
  WHY: This is documentation drift. An operator setting `AI_MEMORY_SINGLE_BRANCH_CLONE_ENABLED=false` would expect a full clone and get the depth-1 clone. Severity is NIT.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3329 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallback reason is logged via `_log.info(...)`, and no logging configuration exists under `scripts/`, so the INFO record is dropped.
  WHY: The `branch_missing` / `clone_failed` reason is invisible in CI, whereas main gates equivalent diagnostics behind `AI_MEMORY_CLONE_DIAGNOSTICS=1`. This is an observability-only NIT.

  confidence=5

  EVIDENCE: The PR head dd8601e fails static-checks (yamllint duplicate key at 71:9), tests-hooks-and-orchestrator (11 failures in tests/test_memory_maintenance_contract_noop.py) and tests-release-and-log-analysis (2 failures in tests/test_ai_memory_git_env_isolation.py), so the block does not clear. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite phrased the requirement as "Unblock #8287 by speeding up memory-branch cloning".

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml:69,71 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR added a second `timeout-minutes: 10` to a step that already had one.
  WHY: yamllint reports a key-duplicates error at 71:9, which fails static-checks and lint. Fix: delete line 71.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3293-3335 (compare 3240-3267) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: With the flag unset, the wrapper runs a full-history single-branch clone (lines 3305-3318, no `--depth`), bypassing the #8287 depth-1 fast path.
  WHY: It fails `test_clone_for_memory_branch_is_shallow_and_single_branch` (lines 312-313) and `test_clone_for_memory_branch_falls_back_to_full_clone_when_fast_clone_fails` (line 404). Each write re-downloads 260k+ commits (135-209 s per clone), so the 20-minute cap can be exhausted again. Fix: reuse the depth-1 path or add `--depth 1`.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3329 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback notice is logged at INFO via a module logger and is likely dropped.
  WHY: The `branch_missing` / `clone_failed` reason is not visible in CI, which is an observability-only issue.
- tests/test_memory_maintenance_contract_noop.py:~507-516 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_legacy_call_args` encodes the pre-#8287 call order, but the actual path starts with `ls-remote`, may do a depth-1 clone, and only then falls back to a full clone. The fake `_run_git` returns an empty `ls-remote` stdout, and the "no --single-branch" assertion cannot hold.
  WHY: tests-hooks-and-orchestrator shows 11 failed and 19 passed with "At index 0 diff: ['ls-remote', ...] != ['clone', ...]". Fix: rebuild the expected sequence from the current `_full_clone_for_memory_branch`.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3228-3230; changelog.d/8295-memory-single-branch-clone.md; agents.d/8295-memory-single-branch-clone.md | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment, changelog and agents fragment describe a depth-1 fast path as a plain full-repo clone. The changelog also overlaps `changelog.d/8287-memory-branch-shallow-clone.md`.
  WHY: This is documentation drift that misleads operators about what the flag restores.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Never put an existing path behind it: with the flag unset, everything that runs today ... keeps running unchanged", and "this change alone must clear the block". | Expected change site: `scripts/ai_memory_lib.py` `_clone_for_memory_branch`, `.github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  Evidence of absence: With the flag unset the clone runs the full-history path instead of main's depth-1 clone with fallback. The PR head fails static-checks, tests-hooks-and-orchestrator (11 failures) and tests-release-and-log-analysis (2 failures).
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py `_memory_single_branch_clone_enabled` lines 3218-3222. The `::warning::` line echoes the raw env value (truncated to 64 characters), which could carry control characters. Fix: `"".join(c if c.isprintable() else "?" for c in raw.strip()[:64])`. Estimated lines changed: 1. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml:69,71 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The step declares `timeout-minutes: 10` twice, once on line 69 (already present) and once on line 71 (added by this PR).
  WHY: yamllint reports `71:9 [key-duplicates]`, which fails static-checks. The workflow cannot ship until the duplicate is removed.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3305-3318 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The wrapper runs `git clone --single-branch --branch <memory_branch> --no-tags --quiet` with no `--depth`, so it fetches the full history.
  WHY: This reproduces the 260k+ commit clone that exhausted the 20-minute job cap in #8287 (run 40752760153), so the "fast" path is not fast.
- tests/test_memory_maintenance_contract_noop.py:506-516, 600-617, 627-649, 557-595 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_legacy_call_args` produces a clone-first sequence, but `_full_clone_for_memory_branch` starts with an `ls-remote` probe and then conditionally takes a `--depth 1` clone or the full-clone branch.
  WHY: 11 parametrized cases fail ("At index 0 diff: ['ls-remote', ...] != ['clone', ...]"). The tests pin a sequence that no production path can produce.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3305-3318 (PERFORMANCE) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: With the flag unset, every `persist_memory_operation` write fetches the entire `ai-memory` history.
  WHY: Two writes per learning re-clone the whole branch, which restores the over-20-minute behaviour. The 10-minute step cap will just cancel the slow extraction step more often.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3228-3230; changelog.d/8295-memory-single-branch-clone.md:1-4; agents.d/8295-memory-single-branch-clone.md:1-2 | severity=NIT | confidence=4

  WHY: The documentation is misleading about what `AI_MEMORY_SINGLE_BRANCH_CLONE_ENABLED=false` restores. There is no runtime crash.
